dt-example.title: SearchBuilder
dt-example.info:
The [SearchBuilder extension](https://datatables.net/manual/extensions/searchbuilder) for DataTables presents the end user with an easy to use UI that allows them to build up complex search expressions. The resulting search term is included in the DataTables state and this example demonstrates the integration between StateRestore and SearchBuilder.
The `searchBuilder` option of `-init stateRestore.include` option is set to `null` in this example, so you can selectively include, or exclude, the SearchBuilder filter in the state.
